messages.subject: URGENT - serious incident at Dudley yesterday
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We had a very serious incident at the Dudley plant yesterday morning - one of our operators, Wayne Tasker, lost the ends of three fingers on a deburring machine. The HSE were on site today and I understand a Prohibition Notice is coming on that machine. We need help, urgently. Can you act for us?

Richard

messages.snippet: Richard, I'm so sorry to hear this. Yes, of course we can act. First and most important: comply full
messages.subject: RE: URGENT - serious incident at Dudley yesterday
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

I'm so sorry to hear this. Yes, of course we can act. First and most important: comply fully with any Prohibition Notice and do not put that machine back into service. Please forward anything the HSE sends you straight to us and route all contact with the inspector through this firm from now on.

Tom Gallagher will handle the day-to-day with me. We'll get an engagement letter and a litigation-hold notice over to you today, and set up a call for tomorrow morning.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
